propositions: Bridge git delivery is abandoned after a single transient transport fault (TLS/DNS/timeout), leaving converged commits unpushed and silently lost.
Transport failures (certificate verification, connection reset, timeout) are treated as terminal like policy violations, receiving zero retries, though they are transient and retriable.
The transport classifier must distinguish between permanent rule violations (policy declines, no retry) and transient network faults (retriable with bounded backoff).

Both the explicit fetch leg in recovery and the promisor on-demand fetch during merge must recognize and retry transport faults with the same classifier and bounded attempt budget of 3 total attempts with 0.5s then 2.0s backoff.
Policy declines must remain strictly terminal after exactly one attempt, unchanged from the existing contract.
Merge conflicts must remain terminal after one merge attempt and not be misclassified as transport-retriable faults.
